title: ID0415899-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002839] IVECO trucks
description:
Reported issue: Left LP does not establish a connection.
Solution: EVCC has issues -> IVECO Problem
yyyy-mm-dd:
Update 3/Apr/2025 - Interoperability issue, already in discussion with IVECO colleagues. Their system is very sensitive and fails in CableCheck. They are proposing a solution from their side.
Update 17/4/2025 - Root Cause is the same and, if it is, it is associated to PSD profile
Update from Energu: Tested IVECO 2.0. and works?
Update from EcoG -
“
We checked with our PLC modem supplier and the root cause of the sessions failing is a reset of the PLC modem on IVECO side. In parallel, we also consulted IVECO and they confirmed that their EVCC is shutting down, but so far they have not been able to conclude what is causing this shutdown.”
Update from 6/june - Ecog to have a final discussion with IVECO, looks like EV issue so nothing for us to, final answer on 12/Jun
Update from 17/June -
So far we haven’t received any update from Iveco side about the root cause of the EVCC shutting down.

additional_info.subject: ID0415899-DC/Si-D/DE-[ MP / R0 170002839 ] Left LP does not establish a connection CRM:02684000028
additional_info.body:
Hello Ralph, good morning.
I checked the logs from the date you presented and found that indeed the EV is not going to charge until some attempts. This is a recent known issue from the IVECO trucks, I can see from the logs, with the vehicle identification: 5c.cc.a0.02.62.a5. Every EV that start with 5c.cc (as far as I know) is always an IVECO truck.
We already brought this to their attention directly as we have been having meetings with them over the past month. They have acknowledged the issue being that their system is very sensitive to certains changes in certain phases.
I will convey the information that you are having this issue so that they can work on a solution.
As soon as I have an update I will come back to you. For now, when the IVECO trucks are failing the sessions please retry until it works.
Thank you very much!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0415899-DC/Si-D/DE-[ MP / R0 170002839 ] Left LP does not establish a connection CRM:02684000028
additional_info.body:
Hello Ralph, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
Update from our side regarding your charging problem with the IVECO trucks.
Our supplier had a discussion with IVECO directly and found that there is a problem with the controller on the vehicle side.
My recommendation is to reach out to this colleague from IVECO and explain the situation, hopefully they will provide you a solution:
leandro.lasciato@ivecogroup.com
From our side, it has been cleared that the problem does not come from the charging station and it's related to the vehicle.
We will close our ticket since it's declared solved.
Thank you and have a nice week ahead.
Best regards,
Francisco
